first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and inherited evidence links shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields to improved early activation. I will verify the two most directly relevant records before committing, while guarding against downstream qualified-revenue dilution by measuring lead quality, conversion, and retention—not just completion.

final.rationale: Run a targeted onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and self-serve prospects, where the verified evidence is most applicable. Shortening onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and retention; SMB signup simplification improved activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline requires safeguards. Measure qualified revenue, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and lead quality—not completion alone—and stop or narrow the test if retention or revenue quality deteriorates.
